# Venture assets and content

Images in rockmywrld/, mystify/ and onz/ are original, unedited images downloaded from Yi Wen’s Wix portfolio on 23 September 2026:
https://yiwenteoh00.wixsite.com/entrepreneurial-vent

CartPool copy and dates are from the user-provided résumé. The existing CartPool and ROCKMY.WRLD logos are reused from assets/. No new venture artwork or reviews were generated.

Edit `dist/portfolio-data.js` → `ventures` to change copy, order, metrics, images, review screenshots and personal reflections. Paths are relative to dist/index.html. Add CartPool screenshots to cartpool/ and set heroImage/gallery. Empty learnings intentionally show an editing placeholder; replace with an array of your own short reflections. ONZ’s date was not verified, so it is omitted.

Original review screenshots are kept intact rather than transcribed or rewritten. Review any customer-identifying details before publishing additional screenshots.
